Each of three starts gets bounded L-BFGS table fit (complete36 contexts, single global identity gauge removed), then physical innovation-plus-shifted-H-response fit using ONLY original128 training records. One extra direct physical fit from old attention endpoint per teacher separates table-pretraining effects. Fixed optimizer termination/caps; report every final endpoint, no selection on transfer energy.
physical_objective: Half carrier-chart innovation relative squared error plus half fixed-teacher-energy-shift H-innovation relative squared error. Full physical amplitude and total-H action reconstructed only from saved1176 features. Not energy minimization, not a fresh variational win.
evaluation: Original128 audit records are already seen. They are ONLY a cached transfer diagnostic, loaded for reporting after all fourteen endpoints are sealed; never called fresh/untouched audit. Report ray, innovation, H response, energy and variance separately. High total-state fidelity alone does not establish reproduction of the carrier improvement.
interpretation: Table rank8 lower bound is an architecture theorem for raw centered output; it is NOT a physical-state lower bound. Failure of bounded physical fitting is inconclusive about global expressivity. Exact table fitting would establish all-context operator reproduction up to common scale; finite cached-state success is not an all-Hilbert-space certificate. No automatic budget extension, architecture change, or GPU release.
